fact: APC's 2023 policy brief states that under the first MINPOSTEL-GIZ/PRADEC convention the town halls (Mairie) of Mayo-Oulo and Bibemi, in the North Region, were each equipped with at least one Wi-Fi access point linked by a long-distance Wi-Fi link to the fibre-fed PAN at Mayo-Oulo and to the Bibemi telecentre, giving access to the internet and to the offline GOON platform; no use by commune staff is named.
title: Réseaux communautaires pour l’inclusion numérique des zones rurales : quelles opportunités pour le Cameroun ?
